
ADD-TAG-TO-FEATURE
Add one or more tags to a feature file (feature-level tags)

USAGE
  fspec add-tag-to-feature <file> <tags...> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <tags...> (required)
    One or more tags to add (e.g., @critical @critical)

OPTIONS
  --validate-registry
    Validate tags against spec/tags.json before adding

EXAMPLES
  1. Add single tag
  $ fspec add-tag-to-feature spec/features/login.feature @critical
  ✓ Added tag @critical to spec/features/login.feature

  2. Add multiple tags
  $ fspec add-tag-to-feature spec/features/login.feature @critical @critical
  ✓ Added tags @critical, @critical to spec/features/login.feature

  3. Add tag with registry validation
  $ fspec add-tag-to-feature spec/features/login.feature @custom-tag --validate-registry
  Error: Tag @custom-tag is not registered in spec/tags.json
Register it first with: fspec register-tag @custom-tag "Category" "Description"

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-tag-from-feature
  fspec list-feature-tags
  fspec add-tag-to-scenario
  fspec register-tag

NOTES
  • Tags must be registered first (unless --validate-registry is skipped)
  • Duplicates are automatically ignored
  • Use --validate-registry to enforce tag registry compliance
